name: Sika Colma Cleaner
paste:
SIKA® COLMA CLEANER: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Colma Cleaner, April 2023, Version 01.04 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/sika_colma_cleaner.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Colma Cleaner where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Colma Cleaner is a grease-free solvent specially formulated for the pre-cleaning of bond faces and the cleaning of tools and equipment.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Colma Cleaner is designed for cleaning surfaces prior to bonding and for cleaning of tools and equipment such as light metals and alloys, steel and stainless steel.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Colma Cleaner
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Solvent-based cleaning agent for substrates and tools
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.04) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ISO 1128-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Density (p.1).
    - ISO 13736: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Flash point (p.1).
    - ISO 3219: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Viscosity (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Easy to use
    - Very powerfeul, fast cleaning
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: One-Component, solvent-based cleaner
    - Colour: Transparent
    - Density: 0.85 kg/l approx. (ISO 1128-1)
    - Viscosity: 1 mPa*s approx. (ISO 3219)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Flash point: 14 °C approx. (ISO 13736)
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 1 l can , 6 cans per box; 20 l Pail
    - Shelf life: Sika® Colma Cleaner has a shelf life of 24 months from the date of production, if it is stored in undamaged, original, sealed packaging, and if the storage conditions are met.
    - Storage conditions: Sika® Colma Cleaner shall be stored in dry conditions, where it is protected from direct sunlight and at temperatures between +5 °C and +25 °C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.04) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: 50 ml/m² approx.
    - Flash-off time: Minimum 15 minutes; Maximum 8 hours
4.3 Application method / tools.
    - Soak a clean rag or lint-free paper towel in Sika® Colma Cleaner and clean the bonding areas to remove surface contamination. Tightly reseal the container immediately after each use.
    - After a flash-off time of 15 minutes apply the appropriate Primer or Aktivator and respect relevant flash-off times again.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations. Sika® Colma Cleaner shall not be used on porous substrates.
4.5 Further information.
    - Safety Data Sheet
    - Pre-treatment Chart Sealing and Bonding

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C to +40 °C, min. 3 °C above dew point temperature
5.3 Substrate temperature. +5 °C to +40 °C
5.4 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Density: 0.85 kg/l approx. (ISO 1128-1)
    - Flash point: 14 °C approx. (ISO 13736)
    - Viscosity: 1 mPa*s approx. (ISO 3219)
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Colma Cleaner, April 2023, Version 01.04, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/sika_colma_cleaner.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika Colma Cleaner, version 08/11/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/Sika%20Colma%20Cleaner.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Colma® Cleaner, version 30/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sds-colma-cleaner.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
